payload.title: Pin the claim-check CLI to 0.11.0 once it is on public npm
payload.body: The version bump part is done: main is at 0.11.0 (PR #10 superseded the 0.10.3 bump from PR #3). 0.10.3 was never published. Remaining: after @tasks-md/cli 0.11.0 is on public npm (curl -s https://registry.npmjs.org/@tasks-md/cli | jq -r '."dist-tags".latest' prints 0.11.0), change CLI_VERSION in .github/workflows/tasks-claim-check.yml to 0.11.0 in a PR with Task/Task-Claim trailers. Checked 2026-10-16: public latest is 0.10.2.
payload.blocked: needs-human-npm-publish — the owner runs the 0.11.0 release (npm publish needs browser 2FA in a real terminal; agents cannot publish). Unblocks when public npm latest is 0.11.0.
